queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT invoice_number, avg_qty, relative_gap, avg_qty - (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) FROM inv) AS diff_above_overall FROM inv WHERE avg_qty > (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) FROM inv) ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_qty AS average_quantity, p.rel_gap AS relative_gap, p.avg_qty - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_qty > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but numeric, so it is cast to a number before averaging.
The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice average quantities, not the mean over all line items. Invoices whose quantities are all NULL are left out of it.
The per-invoice relative gap is computed from summed costs: (SUM(product_cost) - SUM(total_cost)) / SUM(total_cost). A zero total gives NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: The relative gap is computed per line item and then averaged for each invoice, ignoring NULLs.
